current.text: Garland starts at point guard for the Clippers and is projected as their main ball handler.
Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal are out, and Kawhi Leonard is gone. That leaves Garland as the highest-usage player on the Clippers.

A toe injury limited him last season while he was in Cleveland. After the trade deadline, with the Clippers, he played about 30 minutes a night with about 20 points and 7 assists on 29% usage. Over that stretch he ranked 37th per game.
He is expected to be ready for opening night.
Experts expect at least his Clippers production from last season, with more usage. If he is healthy, they expect about 32 minutes a night. A rookie guard will not take over his role.
He goes around 65th on Yahoo and inside the top 50 on ESPN. In a recent 9-cat mock draft he fell to pick 48.
Experts call him undervalued. He could easily be a top 30 player, and a healthy Garland might be top 20. The newest call is to draft him happily in the 40s. Taking him in the 30s is risky.
He is the best fantasy target on the Clippers.
The Clippers do not control their own draft pick, so tanking does not help them. They are expected to try to stay somewhat competitive.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks. They have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league, with 13.

durable.text: He has a long injury record: persistent toe and knee problems and a broken face.
His production drops for a long time after an injury, so he is hard to trust unless he is fully fit.
He is an electric offensive player and a below-average defender.
Assists are his best category and a league outlier. Threes, points and FT% are also clear strengths.
Turnovers are his big weakness. They are high both for the league and for a guard.

note: Garland costs 6.6 USD on average on Yahoo against a Yahoo value of 18 USD, and he went for 11 USD in our league last season. Experts rank him well above his Yahoo rank of 54 and ADP of about 65, so 12 to 18 USD is a fair price for a likely top 50 guard who could reach the top 30. He suits builds that chase assists, threes and FT%, and he is a natural fit for punt TO because of his 3.1 turnovers. Early in the season, check his toe health, whether he gets the expected 32 minutes, and how his usage changes when Ingram returns.
